hypothesis: With one shared global trainable mixed PINN, replacing some fixed input features by cavity-scale Gaussian features improves independent physical residuals relative to a capacity-matched uniform-scale Gaussian/Fourier hybrid and remains competitive with the strongest plain Fourier control. This tests a representation hypothesis, not an established new method or anchoring benefit.
construction: Use exactly K centres and widths from the frozen P1 cover. Gaussian exp(-0.5*sum(((x-c)/h)^2)), no truncation or normalization. Concatenate K Gaussians with the first 1000-K anchored/independent features or the first (1000-K)/2 sine/cosine frequency pairs. One 1000-100-100-5 trainable network, 110705 trainable parameters. Uniform control: exact K farthest points from a regular ceil(2*sqrt(K)) square grid, widths 0.75/sqrt(K); reject candidate centres outside the solid; no local wall-scale adaptation. All coordinates normalized by domain bounding-square length. K depends only on geometry. This comparison isolates the combined centre/scale rule, not centre and scale separately.
construction_audit: C1/T1/S1/L1: exact feature and trainable parameter counts; identical downstream initialization; translation/isotropic-scale invariance after normalization; analytic spatial Jacobian and full objective parameter gradients against independent autograd; float32 full-batch finite gradients; actual collocation maximum response of every Gaussian. Reuse P2A byte-identical point sets on C1/L1 and P2A sampling rule on T1/S1 for preflight only. No optimization on T1/S1.
sampling: Reuse frozen P2A 6000 interior and boundary points/weights exactly. This retains the 90% uniform +10% geometry-only support-probe objective and supplies a direct plain-model reproduction check. No point adaptation, no FEM reads.
precision: float32, TF32 disabled, deterministic algorithms, CPU threads 2, one GPU job
freeze: All 21 terminal fields and their source/input/protocol hashes freeze before independent validation. No checkpoint selection. Record loss, closure counts and peak GPU memory; elapsed times are development telemetry only.

validation.metric: Uniform solid mean of squared five-component mixed strong-form residual, also components/quantiles/top-one-percent mass. Save coordinates and all per-point residuals. Validation is a screening diagnostic, not FEM solution accuracy.

advance_gate: Geometry-RBF-Fourier must achieve mean residual <=0.9 times uniform-RBF-Fourier AND <=1.1 times plain half-Fourier for EVERY case on BOTH held-out sets; independent/train-uniform residual ratio <=10. If these necessary gates pass, register frozen-terminal FEM/engineering evaluation. They do not establish accuracy, efficiency, anchoring benefit or unseen-geometry generalization.
stop: If any advance gate fails, do not expand seeds/cases, change widths, select a hybrid using FEM, or extend this batch. Report all seven representations. Other hybrid results are exploratory and cannot override the primary gate. Any materially new follow-up needs a new rationale/protocol. Stop on nonfinite state, preflight failure, hash mismatch or another project GPU job.
anchoring_attribution: Paired anchored and independent marginal hybrids are diagnostic. No positive anchoring claim without a separately registered exact-bias-permutation control and repetitions.
pretraining_control_correction: Before any optimization, the enclosing-square uniform control had one T1 Gaussian with maximum collocation response 0.0841 because its centre was inside the cavity. Restrict the regular-grid candidate centres to solid membership before farthest selection, retaining exact K and the same global width. This is a uniform-scale control, not geometry-blind. Rerun all construction checks.
